status: frozen before any model fit in this session
question: Does a cross-fitted, label-supervised gradient-boosted surface on the 18 non-catalogue training features beat (a) a random-K control and (b) the registry-039 spacing-five lattice under the same SegmentHoldout evaluator, on whole-component buffered quadrant hide-and-recover?
hypothesis: Visible catalogue labels in the other three quadrants (outside a 15 px collar) teach a per-quadrant classifier which 100 m feature combinations co-occur with mapped faults; the hidden quadrant's components should receive higher emission scores than random cells.
mechanism: Conjunctions of magnetic (rtp, tmi, tmi_hg, tmi_vg, mag_anom), gravity (iso_grav_anom family), conductivity (cond_surf, depth_to_base_surf), terrain (det_elev, det_elev_slope) and geodetic strain (dilatation, shear, second invariant) layers.
named_non_fault_mimic: Rock-type or basin-margin contrasts, survey line/seam artefacts, and conductive cover edges that co-locate with mapped faults without faulting.
features: 18 bands of data/training_features.tif, indices 1-5 and 7-19 (band 6 'tc' excluded per scripts/prepare_data.py). No catalogue-derived feature and no lidar/derived layer is used.
model: sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier, max_iter=200, learning_rate=0.1, max_leaf_nodes=31, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=20261029; training sample = up to 250,000 pixels from fold.train (all visible positives kept up to 60,000) with label fold.visible.
cross_fit: one model per SegmentHoldout quadrant trained with fold.train/fold.visible only; its surface is used only inside that quadrant.
emission: per quadrant: ridge_nms(surface, sigma=1.0) on eligible = quadrant & ~visible, then select_top_positive with K_f = round(37654 * quadrant_pixels / 5167373).

controls.random_K: uniform random cells in eligible with the same K_f, seed 20261029
controls.registry_039_lattice: registry-039 positive cells inside eligible (no budget matching; reported as the registered dense control)

holdout: shared gems.holdout.SegmentHoldout(footprint, catalogue, buffer_px=15), evaluator gems-segment-pooled-v1 (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 3 px triangular kernel), pooled TPw/FPw/FNw, paired block bootstrap CI.
leakage_canary: shared ho.canary() one-feature AUC per feature and for the stitched surface; any AUC > 0.90 means leakage until proven otherwise.
primary_endpoint: HOLDOUT-DTI of the S29 surface minus HOLDOUT-DTI of random-K (paired); success requires the 95% paired CI to exclude zero AND beat the registry-039 lattice on the same evaluator.
promotion_gate: No weekly slot. Promotion requires: primary endpoint success, all canaries < 0.90, surface and final-dot duplicate checks passed under the literal 70%/3 px and 0.90 rank rules against the 46 pinned registry rasters plus the local TIFFs, validator PASS, and an explicit user decision.
budget: one run; no hyperparameter search after seeing holdout results; at most 3 experiments and 2 hours per the user's protocol
not_claimed: No leaderboard estimate. HOLDOUT-DTI is catalogue-internal and is not calibrated to the hidden new-fault test set.
